answer: Problem: cloned keys flood ferrous lagoon grader seats. Mechanism: each identity locks a 0.25 POA bond and must solve a 32-bit PoW ticket H(pubkey||epoch||nonce) before its answer enters the prism ranking queue; tickets are single-use per epoch. Cost: ~4e9 hashes (~40s laptop) plus the locked bond. Verify: peers recompute the ticket hash and reject reused nonces. Failure: if zeros <32 or bond missing, drop the answer and slash 0.05 POA from the bond.
